items.title: Visa (V) Broadens Checkout Options On Its Acceptance Platform
items.summary: Visa (NYSE: V) is expanding its partnership with Klarna to embed Klarna’s payment options into the Visa Acceptance Platform. Merchants in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., and Europe gain access to pay-in-full, interest-free instalments, and longer-term financing at checkout. The Klarna integration is designed to simplify technical setup for merchants by routing multiple payment options through Visa’s existing acceptance infrastructure.
